native.insets: Scaffold safeDrawing consumed once; chat/pairing IME padding. Task-options uses rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true), vertical scrolling and IME padding. Its bottom clearance is the host ViewCompat.getRootWindowInsets(hostView).getInsetsIgnoringVisibility(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.navigationBars()).bottom converted to dp, plus 32dp; the parent has already consumed Compose insets.
native.accessibility: Native Material focus/pressed/disabled behavior; labeled icon controls; SelectionContainer for goals/replies; polite live-region reply updates; 48dp action targets including Latest and removable constraints; FlowRow metadata; font scale 1.3 emulator evidence.
native.status: Expected RK/model startup uses amber notice; actual failures use native Material error roles. Current online paused state is distinct from offline retained snapshots; offline connection repair remains available. Completed replies use the existing semantic green plus a native check-circle and verified wording.
native.previewNote: Self-contained HTML/CSS are illustrative translations for the design panel only; native Compose code, shapes, text measurement, insets and state behavior are authoritative. Preview text is sample content, never shipping task evidence.
native.tonalRampNote: Neutral ramp samples existing native scheme levels; green and amber intermediate shades are panel-only visualizations, not additional shipping tokens.
native.verificationBoundary: Actual Android Emulator 0.5.0 synthetic RK/HID: original verification, secondary, reading and polish reports passed 9, 4, 2 and 4 checks. Final correction report passes four automated continuation checks: online-paused guidance; offline landscape IME send/draft retention; non-IME history measuring 344px in the capture and full 48dp Latest target; offline cached-stopped Reconnect in light and dark/font1.3. The separate restart-stop report passes two checks: automated force-stop/relaunch retains the selected second computer; landscape Stop is confirmed stepwise via native text semantics after stable layout, with stopped=true and the next draft retained. Complete serial-flow rotation/IME timing failures remain in QA history; this is not six uninterrupted automated checks. No new 0.5 real RK/HID result is claimed. The prior real hardware report applies only to Android 0.4.0 plus companion 0.13.0 within its single-window ASCII route; broader task flows and tablet support remain outside evidence.
native.assets: Existing ic_coloop vector preserved; no new shipping raster.
native.responsiveLayout: Phone portrait retains chat app bar, constraint chips, footer hint and up-to-four-line composer. Landscape uses the compact connection header, explicit Resume or repair, inline Stop beside Send, up-to-two-line composer or one line with IME, and options count instead of chip/hint rows. Latest appears only while away from the final lazy row with at least 56 dp weighted history height; 48 dp action plus 8 dp bottom clearance. Main width cap 840 dp is not tablet verification.
native.conversation: Independently keyed goal/reply lazy rows; goal width min(88% available row,560dp); list20dp padding/gaps, goal8dp top/reply8dp bottom; sender/status and source/time wrap independently. Initial pairing retains unsent text and constraints; switching computers clears prior draft, window/completion constraints and reply context.
native.connectionFlows: Devices uses current-computer wording, host-only ordinary address and overflow for secondary destinations. Pairing has three scanner steps, disclosed manual link and compact invitation confirmation. Ordinary Settings prioritizes state and repair; endpoint/identity editing is separate. Explicit removal dialog supports Cancel, online revocation or local-only deletion, and offline local deletion wording. The last selected computer remains preferred on relaunch; polling, sequence reservation and pending-receipt updates replace its stored connection in place, preserving host order.

unitEvidence.boundary: Unit coverage for preferred host order and receipt/sequence updates; native acceptance modes and reports recorded separately.

finalAcceptance.mode: Four automated correction checks continued from independently confirmed native landscape Stop. Restart was automated; Stop was completed stepwise via native semantics after automatic full-flow rotation/IME timing failures. No production code changed for timing failures.
finalAcceptance.dataBoundary: Real Android Emulator/AES-GCM/Keystore; explicitly synthetic model and HID. No new real RK/HID hardware pass.

scopedReview.materialFixes: Both resolved: readable landscape history/full Latest target; offline cached-stopped Settings repair.
scopedReview.scope: Scored correction checklist only; no whole-surface certification. Preferred-host correction and automated-continuation/stepwise-Stop limitations recorded as linked evidence; no new hardware claim.

composer051.message: Keep full in-memory input; 2000 UTF-16 wire limit. Show portrait counter from 1800, field error beyond limit, actionable send validation before connection/admission. No process-death draft persistence.
composer051.options: Sheet-local edits; Done commits both values, Cancel/Back/outside discards. Rotation retains open edits. Overflow validation at 250 window /128 condition; Done disabled until valid. Fields show at most three lines with internal text scrolling.
composer051.status: Only online non-paused RK-connecting snapshots animate, or initial link CONNECTING. Offline cached snapshots do not animate.
composer051.reviewScope: 0.5.0 scoped independent verdict retained as history; no new independent verdict claimed.

taskJourney060.recentTasks: Native sheet capped at 85% of current window; 24dp horizontal padding, weighted lazy list, 48dp All/Unfinished chips. Unfinished excludes only completed/answered; includes awaiting_input, active and unsuccessful outcomes. Last-synced offline wording; select locates original reply. Computer public snapshot is capped at 20, not a persistent full archive.
taskJourney060.compose: Portrait current task offers Supplement or View task. Supplement names original goal, focuses composer/IME and can be cancelled without deleting typed text. Combined original/separator/addition validates against 2000 UTF-16 units. Terminal reuse prepares editable goal; nonblank draft replacement requires Keep/Replace dialog. Preparation clears old options and never sends.
taskJourney060.reconciliation: pendingCheckedId must match current pending UUID for idle-check eligibility. Every confirmation invalidates cached check and requests fresh encrypted snapshot. Failed refresh, host/pending change, active/unconfirmed control, active Coloop or unresolved receipt retains marker. Original task/resolved receipt reconciles without replay; otherwise fresh idle/no receipt enables local acknowledgement only.
taskJourney060.recovery: Inline error actions derive from pairing, link, pending, stopped, active-task and RK availability; preserve draft. Initial unpaired action opens native pair guide.

evidence.reviewStatus: Both material findings resolved; verdict-pass-1.md disposition ship; no visible regression attributable to repair batch. Only two scored fixes, not whole-surface certification.
evidence.correctionScope: One final-APK automated five-check run: cached idle/failed snapshots, newly active snapshot, failed confirmation refresh, fresh idle/no replay, unfinished filter through supplement. First 8+3 checks are separate first-round runs, not one sixteen-check final-APK run. Earlier harness incorrectly waited for activity-hidden action; revised to assert pending footer, no production change for harness timing.
evidence.captureReview: All 15 initial captures reviewed independently; builder opened all changed captures; scoped reviewer independently reopened all eight changed/correction captures. Updated index has 21 valid PNGs.

scopedReview.scope: Fresh admission-uncertainty confirmation and unfinished discovery/selection through supplement only; no whole-surface or new hardware/capability certification.

taskJourney060.boundary: Actual Android Keystore/encrypted gateway/task admission with explicitly synthetic models/HID. No new hardware, QQ Mail, cloud-planning, tablet, durable archive, process-death draft recovery or background-send claim.

narrative.overview:
Coloop's graphite, white, and paired closed-arc mark carry into a native Material 3 phone interface. Typography, touch behavior, fields, dialogs, and sheets follow Android expectations. Brand expression comes from the quiet neutral surfaces and existing vector mark; no new shipping raster asset was added.

This system is extracted from `app/src/main/java/ai/coloop/mobile/MainActivity.kt`, `ColoopChat.kt`, `TaskHistorySheet.kt`, `ColoopModels.kt`, `RemoteViewModel.kt`, and `RemoteRepository.kt`. It is scoped to Android; repository-root `DESIGN.md` and `.impeccable/design.json` describe desktop identity. The user-selected composition and Mode: Operate live in `../docs/android-chat-brief.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Native system sans typography, font scaling, Material controls, and system Back.
Graphite primary actions, tonal neutral surfaces, and restrained semantic status color.
User messages and Coloop replies with distinct alignment and real task state.
Connection repair and safe task controls that preserve the user's draft.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies connection and task-state wording; it never substitutes for that wording. Transport readiness, RK connection, local-model startup, and verified task completion remain distinct states.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Extend Material text roles and preserve system scaling; do not copy desktop Windows text metrics into Android controls.

rules.name: The Native Surface Rule
rules.body: Use Material surfaces and native overlay behavior; preserve the distinction between a persistent message and an interrupting sheet or dialog.

rules.name: The Deliberate Next Action Rule
rules.body: Locate preserves task identity; supplement names its original goal; reuse prepares editable text. Sending always remains a separate user action.

dos: **Do** preserve the paired-arc vector mark and graphite/white identity through native light and dark roles.
**Do** use sp text, native Material focus/pressed states, and at least 48dp action targets.
**Do** keep connection/startup state readable independently of task execution and completion.
**Do** preserve drafts when sending is blocked and keep Stop, explicit Resume, and reconciliation reachable.
**Do** verify phone layouts with system bars, IME, dark theme, and enlarged text using emulator/device captures.
donts: **Don't** treat a receipt or ready connection as proof that a computer task succeeded.
**Don't** replay an old task after reconnection, Resume, or an uncertain response.
**Don't** hide the sheet's final action beneath the keyboard or system navigation area.
**Don't** promote a phone content-width cap into a tablet-support claim.
**Don't** overwrite desktop design artifacts or copy their Windows typography into Android.
